payload.summary: Planned phase 2: a gate-time finding ledger with compact, delta review, tighter blocking, parked disagreement, scoped fixes, and one convergence engine instead of nested PLAN_REVIEW/PLAN_FIX cold re-reviews.

decisions.title: Gate-time ledger only
decisions.rationale: Slice of ambient-review-ledger without the git-hook sensor.

decisions.title: Heuristic compact in v1
decisions.rationale: No extra LLM call; retire on missing file or missing tokens; model compact can replace later.

decisions.title: Disagreement parks rather than aborting
decisions.rationale: Agreed blocking work should continue; parked items surface at SUBMIT_PR.

decisions.title: PLAN_FIX is fix_callback inside converge()
decisions.rationale: The outer bounce was a second engine over the same artifacts.

next_steps: Depends on phase 1 landing. Gate 2 approval, then implement after harden-review-dispatch-parse-and-timeouts.
